# U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
> The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency protects human health and the environment through regulation, research, enforcement, grants, and public information.

EPA.gov is the central federal resource for environmental topics, laws and regulations, compliance and enforcement, scientific research, grants, and public health guidance. It serves the public, regulated entities, researchers, state and tribal partners, and communities seeking environmental data and assistance.

## Core Navigation
- [U.S. Environmental Protection Agency](https://www.epa.gov/): EPA homepage with agency news, featured initiatives, and access to major environmental resources.
- [Environmental Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics): Main directory of EPA topic pages covering air, water, health, waste, and science.
- [A-Z Topic Index](https://www.epa.gov/topics-epa-web): Alphabetical index of EPA topics, programs, tools, and public guidance.
- [Environmental Information by Location](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/environmental-information-by-location): Find EPA information and resources by state, region, and geographic area.
- [EPA News Releases](https://www.epa.gov/newsreleases): Official EPA press releases, announcements, and agency news updates.
- [Research](https://www.epa.gov/research): EPA research programs, scientific assessments, laboratories, and publications.

## Environmental Topics
- [Air Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/air-topics): Resources on air quality, emissions, pollution control, and clean air programs.
- [Water Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/water-topics): Information on drinking water, surface water, wastewater, and water protection programs.
- [Health Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/health-topics): Environmental health information on exposures, risks, and public health protections.
- [Chemicals, Pesticides, and Toxics Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/chemicals-pesticides-and-toxics-topics): EPA resources on chemical safety, pesticides, toxic substances, and risk management.
- [Land, Waste, and Cleanup Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/land-waste-and-cleanup-topics): Guidance on waste management, contaminated sites, cleanup, and land revitalization.
- [Science Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/science-topics): Topic-based access to EPA science, assessments, methods, and technical resources.

## Public Health & Indoor Environment
- [Lead](https://www.epa.gov/lead): Information on lead exposure, health effects, renovation rules, and lead-safe practices.
- [Radon](https://www.epa.gov/radon): Guidance on radon risks, home testing, mitigation, and radon action resources.
- [Mold](https://www.epa.gov/mold): Practical information on mold prevention, cleanup, and indoor moisture control.
- [Bed Bugs](https://www.epa.gov/bedbugs): Bed bug identification, prevention, and integrated pest management guidance.
- [Drinking Water Resources](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/water-topics): EPA water topic hub including drinking water standards and public resources.
- [Health Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/health-topics): Environmental health topic pages for communities, families, and exposed populations.

## Laws, Regulations & Policy
- [Laws & Regulations](https://www.epa.gov/laws-regulations): Gateway to environmental statutes, regulations, rulemakings, and policy materials.
- [Regulatory Information by Business Sector](https://www.epa.gov/regulatory-information-sector): Sector-specific regulatory requirements and environmental guidance for industries and businesses.
- [Regulatory Information by Topic](https://www.epa.gov/regulatory-information-topic): Topic-based access to regulations, guidance, and compliance obligations.
- [Compliance](https://www.epa.gov/compliance): Compliance assistance, monitoring, reporting, and program requirements for regulated entities.
- [Enforcement](https://www.epa.gov/enforcement): EPA enforcement policies, case information, and environmental justice enforcement resources.

## Science, Research & Technical Resources
- [Research](https://www.epa.gov/research): EPA scientific research programs, strategic priorities, and laboratory activities.
- [Science Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/science-topics): Scientific resources organized by environmental issue and technical subject.
- [Emergency Response](https://www.epa.gov/emergency-response): Technical and operational resources for environmental incidents and disaster response.
- [Environmental Information by Location](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/environmental-information-by-location): Regional and local environmental information useful for place-based analysis and response.

## Emergency Response & Cleanup
- [Emergency Response](https://www.epa.gov/emergency-response): EPA response information for oil spills, hazardous releases, and environmental emergencies.
- [Land, Waste, and Cleanup Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/land-waste-and-cleanup-topics): Cleanup, waste, remediation, and contaminated land program resources.
- [Enforcement](https://www.epa.gov/enforcement): Enforcement actions and legal tools related to environmental violations and cleanup obligations.
- [Chemicals, Pesticides, and Toxics Topics](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics/chemicals-pesticides-and-toxics-topics): Chemical hazard and toxic substance resources relevant to emergency planning and response.

## Grants, Contracts & Funding
- [Grants](https://www.epa.gov/grants): EPA grant programs, application guidance, policies, and applicant resources.
- [Contracting](https://www.epa.gov/contracts): Contracting opportunities, acquisition policies, and vendor information for EPA procurements.
- [Budget & Performance](https://www.epa.gov/planandbudget): Agency budget documents, strategic plans, and performance reporting.
- [Applying for EPA Grants](https://www.epa.gov/grants): Central grants page for funding opportunities and application instructions.

## Careers, Agency Information & Governance
- [Careers at EPA](https://www.epa.gov/): EPA homepage featuring agency hiring and careers information.
- [Budget & Performance](https://www.epa.gov/planandbudget): Strategic planning, budget justification, and agency performance materials.
- [No FEAR Act Data](https://www.epa.gov/ocr/no-fear-act-data): Required reporting on equal employment opportunity and workplace rights data.
- [EPA Web Snapshot](https://www.epa.gov/utilities/wwwepagov-snapshots): Archived snapshots of EPA.gov content for historical reference.

## Accessibility, Privacy & Web Policies
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.epa.gov/accessibility/epa-accessibility-statement): EPA accessibility policy and support information for website users.
- [Privacy and Security Notice](https://www.epa.gov/privacy/privacy-and-security-notice): Privacy, security, and information handling practices for EPA.gov.
- [Plain Writing](https://www.epa.gov/web-policies-and-procedures/plain-writing): EPA plain language policy and writing standards for public communications.
- [Assistance](https://www.epa.gov/lep/assistance): Language assistance resources for people with limited English proficiency.

## Multilingual Resources
- [Spanish](https://espanol.epa.gov/): Spanish-language EPA site with environmental health and program information.
- [Arabic](https://www.epa.gov/lep/arabic): Arabic-language environmental health and assistance resources from EPA.
- [Chinese (Simplified)](https://www.epa.gov/lep/simplified-chinese): Simplified Chinese environmental health and assistance materials.
- [Chinese (Traditional)](https://www.epa.gov/lep/traditional-chinese): Traditional Chinese environmental health and assistance materials.
- [French](https://www.epa.gov/lep/french): French-language environmental health and assistance resources.
- [Haitian Creole](https://www.epa.gov/lep/sante-ak-anviwonman-enfomasyon-kreyol-ayisyen): Haitian Creole environmental health and assistance information.
- [Korean](https://www.epa.gov/lep/korean): Korean-language environmental health and assistance resources.
- [Portuguese](https://www.epa.gov/lep/saude-e-informacoes-ambientais-em-portugues): Portuguese environmental health and assistance information.
- [Russian](https://www.epa.gov/lep/russian): Russian-language environmental health and assistance resources.
- [Tagalog](https://www.epa.gov/lep/tagalog): Tagalog environmental health and assistance resources.
- [Vietnamese](https://www.epa.gov/lep/vietnamese): Vietnamese-language environmental health and assistance resources.
